draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Vizhinjam! Pottery found here shows it has been part of Indian Ocean trade since at least the 2nd century BCE. Now it's home to India's first deep-water transshipment port, opened on 2 May 2025.
draft.hungryLine: The local speciality is chicken fry at Kovalam Junction, and there's grilled seafood along Lighthouse Beach.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the cave temple right here, then walk down to the harbour and the old lighthouse.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Watch the sunset at the harbour, with the fishing boats coming in.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The port's breakwater is India's deepest, reaching 28 metres, about the height of a nine-storey building.

spots.name: Vizhinjam Rock Temple
spots.detail: 1 min walk · Granite cave shrine with unfinished Shiva reliefs

spots.name: Vizhinjam Harbour
spots.detail: By the sea · Sunset with the seaside mosque

spots.name: Vizhinjam Lighthouse
spots.detail: Southern beach · One of Kerala's oldest lighthouses

legends.title: The lost port of Balita
legends.body: An ancient text, the Periplus of the Erythrean Sea, names a coastal town called Balita. Some think it was Vizhinjam.

legends.title: Shiva with the Ganga
legends.body: At Azhimala, an 18 m Gangadhareshwara sculpture shows Shiva as the bearer of the Ganga. It's the tallest Shiva sculpture in Kerala.

tips.title: Visit the lighthouse at 3 PM.
tips.body: Vizhinjam Lighthouse is open to visitors from 3 to 5 PM daily.

tips.title: Head back after sunset.
tips.body: Unless you're with a guide, it's best to go back to Kovalam once the sun is down.

story.title: Early traders
story.body: Pottery finds show Vizhinjam was part of Indian Ocean trade by at least this time.

story.title: The Ay kingdom
story.body: The Ay dynasty controlled the region during these centuries.

story.title: A new port
story.body: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Vizhinjam International Seaport, India's first deep-water transshipment port.

story.title: Ships on the doorstep
story.body: The port is just 10 nautical miles from a busy east-west shipping route, with a natural depth of 24 metres.

food.name: Suprabatham
food.detail: One of the best vegetarian places in Kovalam
